Appearance:
 Shri Krishan Kumar Kushwaha - Advocate for the applican
 Ms. Samta Jain- Government Advocate for the respondent/
 Shri Eshwar Das Vaishy - Advocate for the objector.

Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

2. The applicant is in custody since 04.04.2024 in connection with Crime No.324/2024 registered at P.S.-Morwa, District- Singroli (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 506 of IPC and Section 4 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (POA) Act.

3. As per the prosecution story, allegations against the present applicant are that on 25.03.2024, in the night, when prosecutrix went outside from her house for attending nature's call, then, accused came there and forcibly took away her and thereafter he committed rape with her.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in the instant case, incident is said to have occurred on 25.03.2024 and FIR was lodged on 02.04.2024 on the basis of written report and therein it was mentioned that applicant molested prosecutrix.
Therein, it is not mentioned that applicant forcibly established NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46019 2 MCRC-38611-2024 physical relation with prosecutrix against her will.
During investigation and at the time of filing a charge sheet, offence under Section 376 of IPC was added.

It is also urged that no Rahul Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72508070/
1 injury has been found on the body of prosecutrix and DNA report does not support the prosecution story.

sentences.text: Charge sheet has been filed and prosecutrix and her mother have been examined.
He further submits that the trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.

5. Learned counsel for the objector as well as learned counsel for the State, after referring to prosecutrix statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., submits that applicant has established physical relation with prosecutrix against her will and it is also urged that during commission of offence prosecutrix sustained injury.
Therefore, they have prayed for dismissal of the bail application.

6. Having regard to written report lodged by prosecutrix on 02.04.2024 with respect to incident dated 25.03.2024 as well as other evidence available on record, including medical evidence, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant-Rahul Yadav be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.

However, in case of bail NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46019 3 MCRC-38611-2024 jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail,
it shall become ineffective.
9. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
